verdict.rationale: cubic runs unattended as a hosted GitHub app: it automatically reviews every new PR, can auto-fix issues and can auto-approve low-risk PRs. It also ships a CLI that reviews local changes, but nothing documents running that CLI headlessly in a CI pipeline. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions usage), non-interactive CLI flags or exit codes for build gating, headless auth/token setup for CI runners, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push.
turn on auto-fix to have cubic fix the issues from every review of a pull request.
Auto-approval lets you skip human review for pull requests that cubic determines are low risk and issue-free.
